How to close more estimates on the same visit. For plumbing, HVAC and electrical business owners.
ServiceTitan data (participating customers, 12 months to Jan 2026): the top 10% of contractors by revenue closed 77% of their estimates during the same visit. Everyone else: 62%.

Quote Clinic, Lesson 5: ask before you leave the driveway. Say this:
"Here are your options."
"If you want to go ahead today, I can get you on the schedule for [day]."
"What questions do you have before you pick one?"

That last question brings the worry out while you're still there to answer it. ServiceTitan says same-visit closes show how well a tech handles objections, frames financing and asks for the sale.
It's a pattern, not proof: ServiceTitan says these behaviors are correlated with higher performance, not shown to cause it.

Send this to whoever goes out on your estimates.
